$comment: One entry per skill catalog. scripts/gen-skills-catalog.mjs (frontmatter, packaging) and scripts/check-skill-contracts.mjs (verbs, cross-catalog names, protocol copies) iterate every entry, each with its own prefix and verb regex.

outputs names the build outputs a catalog feeds. null means the catalog is kept out of that output on purpose: the ow- catalog has its own zip and public mirror tree; it stays out of the dev plugin, docs tree, flag registry and hosted MCP catalog.

The scripts that write those outputs (sync-plugin-skills, sync-skill-bundles, make-skills-zip, sync-docs, gen-mcp-catalog) refuse a source tree holding any skill outside the oc- prefix, so pointing OPCHAIN_SKILLS_DIR at skills-work/ fails before anything is deleted or written.

edges names the per-skill edges file (ow- contract R15). planned lists unavailable family skills; plannedVerbs declares future verbs a NEXT block may name. The ten built ow- skills, including care and vendor evaluation, have reciprocal edges checked from their own skill.edges.yaml files. bodyTokenBudgets caps individual skill bodies. statusNames names what a verb STATUS line must carry. Index-only reads name records without claiming an execution handoff.

Owner scope amendment 2026-10-23 restores ow-care and ow-vendor-eval to v2.1. ow-currency and ow-controls remain planned for v2.2. /ow-currency-watch remains declared for the future handoff, though no ow-research screen names it in v2.1. The built ow-research, ow-draft and ow-vendor-eval handoffs are reciprocal; formal vendor evaluation cannot feed a draft recommendation.
